note: Wooded park in the Turtle River valley near Arvilla, west of Grand Forks. The modern sites sit in two shaded loops on the slope above the river; the primitive sites are walk-in tent sites in the river bottom. Camping cabins, full-service cabins open all year, and groomed cross-country ski trails in winter. --Claude
summary: Park page + reserveNDparks: 67 modern 50-amp + water sites ($25/$30 Sat), 3 group, 26 walk-in primitive tent sites ($15); base $25 stands. Hookups electric 50 added, water confirmed; count 96 confirmed manual; showers, flush toilets, dump. Not waterfront stands (modern loops ~120 m+ from the river through woods). PIN MOVE ~750 m to the modern loops. Season: online booking May 1-Oct 31 2027 vs stored manual year_round (flag).
